title: Token-2022 in-place metadata
detects: An authority that can rewrite the token's name, symbol, URI and additional metadata fields in place, on the mint itself.
knownFalseNegative: This is the only Token-2022 extension that can be added to a mint after it has been initialised, because it is variable-length. A mint without it today can gain it later, so its absence is weaker evidence than the absence of any other extension in this dictionary.
rationale: Distinct from the metadata pointer: one moves where the metadata is read from, the other rewrites what it says. A token could revoke either and keep the other, and reporting them as one capability would hide that.
